disclaimer: AI-Assisted Preliminary Assessment. Manual verification required. These prototype checks do NOT represent the complete Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011.

rules.name: Name / Identity of Commodity
rules.description: Common or generic name of the packaged commodity.

rules.name: Manufacturer / Packer / Importer Details
rules.description: Name of the manufacturer, packer, or importer responsible for the commodity.

rules.name: Complete Address
rules.description: Physical address including postal pincode of the manufacturer/packer.

rules.name: Net Quantity
rules.description: Net quantity in standard metric units of weight, measure, or count (e.g. g, kg, ml, L, N).

rules.name: Maximum Retail Price (MRP)
rules.description: Retail sale price inclusive of all taxes in Indian Rupees.

rules.name: Date Declaration
rules.description: Month and year of manufacture or packing (e.g., PKD or Mfg Date).

rules.name: Consumer Care / Contact Details
rules.description: Name, address, telephone number, or email for consumer grievances.
